capture.screen.start.note: FR-EXP-001a's sitting. 'Reeks' rather than 'batch' — a Dutch bookkeeper says reeks, and batch is an English loan that means something narrower here.

capture.screen.take_photo.note: FR-EXP-001's camera path. 'Single tap from the home screen' is what this is.

capture.screen.choose_files.note: FR-EXP-001's upload path — file picker. Drag-and-drop lands in the same place.

capture.screen.drop_hint.note: The drop zone. Names the formats FR-EXP-001 accepts, because 'unsupported file' after the fact is a worse way to learn them.
capture.screen.drop_hint.nl: Sleep facturen of bonnen hierheen — JPEG, PNG, HEIC of PDF
capture.screen.drop_hint.en: Drop invoices or receipts here — JPEG, PNG, HEIC or PDF

capture.screen.add_page.note: FR-EXP-001's multi-page. Deliberately worded as belonging to THIS receipt: pressing it must not feel like starting another one, because the difference is one expense or two.
capture.screen.add_page.nl: Nog een pagina van deze bon

capture.screen.new_receipt.note: FR-EXP-001a's batch. The counterpart to add_page, and the pair is why neither is inferred.

capture.screen.finalise.note: Accepts the review list and closes the sitting. Posts nothing (ADR-031 §5).

capture.screen.finalised.note: Shown after finalisation. Says what happens next, because 'done' alone leaves the person wondering whether the money has moved. It has not — the forms still have to be filled in.
capture.screen.finalised.nl: Reeks afgerond. Vul de bonnen aan wanneer het uitkomt; er is nog niets geboekt.
capture.screen.finalised.en: Batch finished. Fill the receipts in whenever it suits; nothing has been posted yet.

capture.screen.expenses_to_create.note: FR-EXP-001a: what finalising would produce, stated before the person commits. One per RECEIPT — pages do not count, and that is the whole distinction.

capture.screen.nothing_captured.nl: Nog geen bonnen in deze reeks.
capture.screen.nothing_captured.en: No receipts in this batch yet.

capture.problem.offline_cannot_start.note: The one thing a sitting genuinely cannot do offline: the session id is allocated by the server. Everything after it works without a connection. See ADR-036's known gaps.
capture.problem.offline_cannot_start.nl: Een nieuwe reeks starten kan alleen met verbinding. Bonnen die al in de wachtrij staan worden gewoon geüpload.
capture.problem.offline_cannot_start.en: Starting a new batch needs a connection. Receipts already in the queue still upload on their own.

capture.problem.offline_cannot_finalise.nl: Afronden kan alleen met verbinding. De bonnen zijn veilig opgeslagen op dit apparaat.
capture.problem.offline_cannot_finalise.en: Finishing needs a connection. The receipts are stored safely on this device.

capture.problem.pages_not_uploaded.note: The server refuses a session holding a receipt with no stored original (ADR-031 §5). From a client with a queue that always means the pages have not landed yet, which is a different sentence from a generic refusal and by far the common one.
capture.problem.pages_not_uploaded.nl: Nog niet alle bonnen zijn geüpload. Wacht tot de wachtrij leeg is en probeer het opnieuw.
capture.problem.pages_not_uploaded.en: Not every receipt has uploaded yet. Wait until the queue is empty and try again.

capture.problem.refused.note: {detail} is the sentence the API already translated into the reader's language (FR-UX-007) — the one place a screen shows text that did not come from this catalogue.

capture.quality.title.note: FR-EXP-001's glare and blur warning. A question, not a verdict — the checks are heuristics and they warn rather than refuse.
capture.quality.title.nl: Deze foto is misschien niet goed genoeg
capture.quality.title.en: This photograph may not be good enough

capture.quality.glare.note: Blown-out areas have lost their information entirely — no later processing recovers text from them.
capture.quality.glare.nl: Er valt licht op de bon; een deel is overbelicht.
capture.quality.glare.en: There is glare on the receipt; part of it is washed out.

capture.quality.retake.note: FR-EXP-001's 'retake prompt'. First and default, because a retake is one tap while the receipt is still in the person's hand.

capture.quality.use_anyway.note: Always offered. A blurred photograph of a receipt is worth more than no photograph of it, and FR-EXP-001c is explicit that the product never blocks.

capture.review.receipt.note: One row. {position} is its place in the sitting, which is the order the pile of paper is in.

capture.review.pages.note: Stored ORIGINALS, not sheets: a four-page PDF is one (ADR-031). Worth showing, because it is what tells somebody a three-page invoice was captured as one receipt rather than three.

capture.review.duplicate.note: A byte-identical capture earlier in the same sitting — the same receipt photographed twice, which a batch makes common. Flags rather than refuses: two identical receipts can be legitimate.
capture.review.duplicate.nl: Deze foto is identiek aan een eerdere bon in deze reeks.
capture.review.duplicate.en: This photograph is identical to an earlier receipt in this batch.

capture.purchases.count.note: Context line beside the Purchases heading: how many invoices are listed.

capture.purchases.col.ledger.note: RGS is the Dutch reference chart of accounts; the abbreviation is kept in both languages like BTW.

capture.purchases.status.draft.note: A captured invoice nobody has confirmed yet. Named for what the person does next.

capture.book.ready_note.note: On a purchase that is complete but not yet in the ledger. Says what booking does, in the reader's terms: it is what makes the purchase count.
capture.book.ready_note.nl: Klaar om te boeken. Boeken zet deze inkoop in uw administratie en telt de voorbelasting mee in de btw-aangifte.
capture.book.ready_note.en: Ready to book. Booking puts this purchase in your books and counts its input BTW on your BTW return.

capture.book.not_permitted.note: An Expense Submitter's view of a ready purchase: posting is not theirs to do (Appendix A, SoD).
capture.book.not_permitted.nl: Ingediend. Iemand met boekhoudrechten boekt deze inkoop.
capture.book.not_permitted.en: Submitted. Someone with bookkeeping rights will book this purchase.

capture.book.all_failed.nl: {count} inkopen konden niet worden geboekt. Open ze om te zien waarom.
capture.book.all_failed.en: {count} purchases could not be booked. Open them to see why.

capture.purchases.unread_title.note: Stands in for the supplier of an invoice with nothing filled in yet.

capture.purchases.empty_body.note: Says what happens when the first one is added, because the drop zone above is the next step.
capture.purchases.empty_body.nl: Voeg hierboven uw eerste factuur toe. We lezen de datum, het bedrag en de leverancier voor u uit.
capture.purchases.empty_body.en: Add your first invoice above. We read the date, amount and supplier for you.

capture.purchases.original_error.nl: De originele factuur kon niet worden geladen.
capture.purchases.original_error.en: The original invoice could not be loaded.

capture.read.done.note: Shown on an invoice whose fields were filled by automatic reading. Asks for a check, because a reading is a suggestion.
capture.read.done.nl: We hebben deze factuur automatisch gelezen. Controleer de gemarkeerde velden voordat u indient.
capture.read.done.en: We read this invoice automatically. Please check the marked fields before you submit.

capture.read.submitted.note: The invoice's own VAT rate was read with enough certainty (21% or 9%) that the claim was submitted automatically - nothing left to review here.
capture.read.submitted.nl: We hebben deze factuur automatisch gelezen en ingediend. Er is niets meer om te controleren.
capture.read.submitted.en: We read this invoice automatically and submitted it. There's nothing left for you to review.

capture.read.failed.nl: We konden deze factuur niet automatisch lezen. Vul de gegevens hieronder zelf in.
capture.read.failed.en: We couldn't read this invoice automatically. Please fill in the details below.

capture.read.failed_busy.note: ADR-095. The reading service limited our requests, erred, or did not answer in time — transient, so it offers the retry.
capture.read.failed_busy.nl: De leesdienst was even niet beschikbaar. Probeer het zo opnieuw, of vul de gegevens hieronder zelf in.
capture.read.failed_busy.en: The reading service was briefly unavailable. Try reading again shortly, or fill in the details below.

capture.read.failed_setup.note: ADR-095. The reading service refused our key or the request (a wrong model id, a revoked key) — configuration, which a retry will not fix until an administrator does.
capture.read.failed_setup.nl: Automatisch lezen is niet goed ingesteld. Vul de gegevens hieronder zelf in; een beheerder moet de instellingen controleren.
capture.read.failed_setup.en: Automatic reading is not set up correctly. Fill in the details below; an administrator needs to check its settings.

capture.read.check.note: Beside a field the reading was not sure of.

capture.category.title.note: Heading of the dialog that opens when receipts are added. The category is asked BEFORE the file is sent, so the receipt arrives already filed (FR-EXP-001b).
capture.category.title.en: What kind of expense is this?

capture.category.subtitle.note: RGS is the Dutch reference chart of accounts (Referentie GrootboekSchema); the abbreviation is kept in both languages like BTW.
capture.category.subtitle.nl: Kies een categorie — we boeken het op de juiste grootboekrekening (RGS).
capture.category.subtitle.en: Pick a category — we book it to the right ledger account (RGS).

capture.category.applies_to.note: Says how many files the one choice covers, because a drop of several files is filed under one category.

capture.category.meta.note: Under each category: its reference ledger account and default BTW. {rgs} is the account number, {vat} is the existing capture.vat.* label.

capture.uploads.title.note: Heading of the overview of everything added in this batch, with where each one is on its way.

capture.uploads.summary.note: Progress of the batch. {done} of {total} receipts are on the server.

capture.uploads.empty.nl: Nog niets geüpload. Voeg hierboven bonnen toe.
capture.uploads.empty.en: Nothing uploaded yet. Add receipts above.

capture.uploads.list_label.nl: Bonnen in deze reeks en hun uploadstatus
capture.uploads.list_label.en: Receipts in this batch and their upload status

capture.form.gross_amount.note: FR-EXP-001b asks for the GROSS amount — the figure printed on the receipt — because that is the one a person can read off without doing arithmetic. VAT and net are derived.

capture.form.vat_treatment.note: FR-EXP-001b calls this 'VAT rate'. The form shows a rate; what is stored is the treatment, because a rate is a fact about a treatment on a date (CMP-014). Identical because BTW is a statutory term that keeps its Dutch form in the English UI (FR-LOC-001c).

capture.form.payment_method.note: FR-EXP-001e. Captured at entry because it decides the posting and cannot be inferred later.

capture.form.derived.note: The computed figures, shown and never typed. Accepting them would let a client assert a number the database is about to disagree with.

capture.form.suggested_category.note: FR-EXP-001b's 'defaulting from the user's history'. Offered, not applied — a default that overwrote a choice would be a correction.

capture.form.mark_ready.note: Releases the claim to FR-EXP-002's approval. Not 'submit', which would suggest the money is moving.

capture.form.still_needed.note: FR-EXP-001b: what is still outstanding, all at once, rather than discovered one field at a time. FR-EXP-001c means a partly-filled form is the normal state, so this is information rather than an error.
capture.form.still_needed.nl: Nog nodig om in te dienen: {fields}

capture.form.field.vat_treatment.note: Identical because BTW is a statutory term that keeps its Dutch form in the English UI (FR-LOC-001c). See glossary.json.

capture.vat.btw_vrijgesteld.note: Vrijgesteld — exempt from BTW. Kept Dutch in both, like BTW itself: it names a specific statutory position on a Dutch return, and 'exempt' invites an English reader to reason with their own country's rules (FR-LOC-001c).

capture.vat.btw_verlegd.note: Verlegd — the reverse charge. Kept Dutch for the same reason; it is what the invoice itself says.

capture.vat.btw_icp.note: Intra-community supply, filed under the Dutch acronym ICP. See glossary.json.

capture.payment.personal_reimbursable.note: FR-EXP-001e's reimbursable case — the one that means the business owes this person money, which FR-EXP-003's run pays. Worth naming as such rather than as 'personal', so the consequence is visible at the moment of choosing.

capture.duplicate.title.note: FR-EXP-001g. Almost always a warning, not a block: two identical receipts can be legitimate. ADR-101's one exception (the invoice number also matches) is already reflected in can_be_marked_ready, not in this heading.

capture.duplicate.confirmed.note: ADR-101. Shown when the invoice number also matches - near-certain the same document, and the reason the submit button below is disabled.
capture.duplicate.confirmed.nl: Zelfde leverancier, datum, bedrag én factuurnummer als hieronder — vrijwel zeker hetzelfde document. Dit kan niet worden ingediend voordat dit is opgelost.
capture.duplicate.confirmed.en: Same supplier, date, amount and invoice number as below — almost certainly the same document. This cannot be submitted until it is resolved.

capture.duplicate.invoice_number_same.note: ADR-101. Beside the specific matching claim that also shares the invoice number.

capture.duplicate.invoice_number_missing.note: ADR-101. A parking ticket has no invoice number - nothing rules a duplicate out, worth saying even though it does not block.

capture.duplicate.entry.note: Identical because it is entirely placeholders — a supplier's name, a date and an amount, each already rendered in the administration's locale (FR-LOC-002). There is no prose here to translate.

capture.duplicate.same_submitter.note: Their own double entry is a mistake to fix.
capture.duplicate.same_submitter.nl: Deze hebt u zelf al ingediend.

capture.duplicate.other_submitter.note: A colleague's is a conversation to have, and WHO stays out of it — a duplicate check is a poor place to learn what one's colleagues spend.
capture.duplicate.other_submitter.nl: Iemand anders heeft een vrijwel gelijke uitgave ingediend.
capture.duplicate.other_submitter.en: Someone else submitted an almost identical expense.

capture.duplicate.blocked.note: ADR-116. The ONLY duplicate sentence left on the invoice itself: a confirmed duplicate (ADR-101, the invoice number also matches) disables Submit, and a disabled button with no reason is the one thing worse than a loud banner. Everything else is said once, at the upload.
capture.duplicate.blocked.nl: Hetzelfde factuurnummer staat al in uw lijst, dus deze factuur kan niet worden ingediend.
capture.duplicate.blocked.en: The same invoice number is already on your list, so this invoice can't be submitted.

capture.duplicate.upload.list_label.note: ADR-116. Region label for the notices shown after an upload that looks like an invoice already on the list.

capture.duplicate.upload.title.same_file.note: ADR-116. The exact same file (identical bytes) as one already stored for this client. Needs no reading, so it is also said when reading failed.
capture.duplicate.upload.title.same_file.nl: Dit bestand staat al in uw lijst
capture.duplicate.upload.title.same_file.en: This file is already on your list

capture.duplicate.upload.title.same_invo.note: ADR-116. Supplier, date, amount AND invoice number match: ADR-101's near-certain duplicate, the one case that blocks submitting.
capture.duplicate.upload.title.same_invo.nl: Deze factuur lijkt op een factuur die u al hebt
capture.duplicate.upload.title.same_invo.en: This invoice looks like one you already have

capture.duplicate.upload.title.same_deta.note: ADR-116. Supplier, date and amount match but the invoice number differs or is missing - possibly a second real invoice, so said quietly.
capture.duplicate.upload.title.same_deta.nl: Lijkt op een factuur die u al hebt
capture.duplicate.upload.title.same_deta.en: Similar to an invoice you already have

capture.duplicate.upload.body.same_file.note: ADR-116. {file} is the uploaded file's name; {existing} is the existing invoice as supplier · date · amount (capture.duplicate.entry). The upload is kept either way: a refused upload is a lost document.
capture.duplicate.upload.body.same_file.nl: {file} is precies hetzelfde bestand als {existing}. Het is toch bewaard.
capture.duplicate.upload.body.same_file.en: {file} is exactly the same file as {existing}. It was kept anyway.

capture.duplicate.upload.body.same_invoi.nl: {file} heeft dezelfde leverancier, datum, bedrag en factuurnummer als {existing}. Het kan niet worden ingediend zolang dit niet is opgelost.
capture.duplicate.upload.body.same_invoi.en: {file} has the same supplier, date, amount and invoice number as {existing}. It can't be submitted until this is resolved.

capture.duplicate.upload.body.same_detai.nl: {file} heeft dezelfde leverancier, datum en bedrag als {existing}, maar een ander factuurnummer. Mogelijk is het een tweede factuur.
capture.duplicate.upload.body.same_detai.en: {file} has the same supplier, date and amount as {existing}, but a different invoice number. It may be a second invoice.

capture.duplicate.upload.body.same_detai.nl: {file} heeft dezelfde leverancier, datum en bedrag als {existing}, maar er is geen factuurnummer om te vergelijken, dus een dubbele factuur is niet uit te sluiten.
capture.duplicate.upload.body.same_detai.en: {file} has the same supplier, date and amount as {existing}, but there is no invoice number to compare, so a duplicate can't be ruled out.

capture.duplicate.upload.more.note: ADR-116. When more than one existing invoice matches: the one named is the closest, this counts the rest.

nl.one: En nog {count} andere factuur lijkt hierop.
nl.other: En nog {count} andere facturen lijken hierop.

en.one: {count} other invoice looks like it too.
en.other: {count} other invoices look like it too.

capture.duplicate.upload.discard.note: ADR-117. Throws the just-uploaded draft away. Its file is kept (FR-DOC-002); only the draft leaves the list.

capture.duplicate.discard.button.note: ADR-117. Beside the sentence that explains a disabled Submit - the way out of a confirmed duplicate.

capture.duplicate.discard.confirm.nl: Deze factuur weggooien? Het bestand blijft bewaard.
capture.duplicate.discard.confirm.en: Discard this invoice? The file is kept.

capture.duplicate.discard.failed.note: Fallback when the server gave no sentence of its own.
capture.duplicate.discard.failed.nl: Het weggooien is niet gelukt. Probeer het opnieuw.
capture.duplicate.discard.failed.en: Discarding did not work. Please try again.

capture.duplicate.upload.dismiss_label.note: Accessible name for the dismiss button; {file} says which notice it closes when there are several.

capture.duplicate.upload.unnamed_file.note: ADR-116. What an upload is called in the notice when its file had no name (a camera photograph).

capture.details.invoice_title.note: Heading of the read-only card of everything read from the invoice, shown once it is submitted (a draft shows the editable form instead).

capture.details.none.note: Placeholder for a fact that is not known - an em dash, so a gap reads as a gap and not as a blank.

capture.details.vat.note: BTW is a statutory term and keeps its Dutch form in the English UI (FR-LOC-001c).

capture.details.history.submitted_auto.note: The reading was certain of the VAT rate, so the invoice went to ready without a person (FR-AP-002).

capture.details.history.submitted.note: No time is kept for a manual submission, so this entry has no date.

capture.queue.title.note: Heading of the offline capture queue panel (FR-EXP-001f, MOB-003).

capture.queue.list_label.note: Accessible name of the list of queued captures.
capture.queue.list_label.nl: Bonnen die nog geüpload moeten worden

capture.queue.empty.note: Nothing is waiting. Says the positive thing rather than showing an empty box, which is indistinguishable from a panel that failed to load.

capture.queue.offline.note: MOB-003's visible queue state while there is no connection. Says what will happen without asking the person to do anything, because there is nothing they can do.
capture.queue.offline.nl: Geen verbinding. Bonnen worden vanzelf geüpload zodra er weer verbinding is.
capture.queue.offline.en: No connection. Receipts upload on their own as soon as there is one again.

capture.queue.uploading_now.note: How many captures are in flight.

capture.queue.blocked_count.note: How many captures the server refused in a way retrying cannot fix.

capture.queue.delivered_count.note: Progress during a drain, so a queue that is emptying visibly is emptying.

capture.queue.storage.note: MOB-009's size cap, shown so a queue approaching it is not a surprise. MB is a unit symbol and is written the same in both languages.

capture.queue.item_label.note: Accessible name of one queued capture. A queued receipt has not been read yet — there is no supplier and no amount — so its position in the queue and the day it was photographed are the only things that distinguish it. Position is what carries the distinction when several were photographed on one day.

capture.queue.state.blocked.note: Not 'failed'. The capture is still on the device and the next line says what to do about it.

capture.queue.attempts.note: Shown once a capture has failed at least once, so a queue that is stuck looks stuck rather than idle.

capture.queue.retry_label.note: Accessible name of the retry button, which needs to name WHICH receipt — a list of identical 'Try again' buttons is unusable with a screen reader.

capture.queue.discard_label.note: Accessible name of the discard button. Names the receipt, and says the photograph goes with it — on a phone with no connectivity this queue holds the only copy.
capture.queue.discard_label.nl: Bon {position} weggooien; de foto wordt van dit apparaat verwijderd
capture.queue.discard_label.en: Discard receipt {position}; the photograph is removed from this device

capture.queue.reason.unsupported_type.note: FR-EXP-001 accepts JPEG, PNG, HEIC and PDF; the archive verifies it from the bytes (SEC-005). Names the formats, because 'unsupported' alone leaves the person with no next step.
capture.queue.reason.unsupported_type.nl: Dit bestandstype wordt niet geaccepteerd. Gebruik JPEG, PNG, HEIC of PDF.
capture.queue.reason.unsupported_type.en: This file type is not accepted. Use JPEG, PNG, HEIC or PDF.

capture.queue.reason.infected.note: SEC-005's malware scan rejected the file.
capture.queue.reason.infected.nl: Dit bestand is geweigerd door de virusscan.
capture.queue.reason.infected.en: This file was rejected by the malware scan.

capture.queue.reason.too_large_for_serve.nl: Dit bestand is te groot om te bewaren. Maak een nieuwe foto of gebruik een kleiner bestand.
capture.queue.reason.too_large_for_serve.en: This file is too large to store. Take a new photograph or use a smaller file.

capture.queue.reason.session_closed.note: FR-EXP-001a: the review list was accepted, so nothing further can join that sitting. The receipt is still on the device and belongs in a new one.
capture.queue.reason.session_closed.nl: Deze reeks is al afgerond. Leg de bon vast in een nieuwe reeks.
capture.queue.reason.session_closed.en: This batch has already been completed. Capture the receipt in a new batch.

capture.queue.reason.not_permitted.note: IAM-030: authorization is evaluated against current state, so a grant may have gone since the photograph was taken.
capture.queue.reason.not_permitted.nl: U mag geen bonnen meer indienen voor deze klant.
capture.queue.reason.not_permitted.en: You are no longer allowed to submit receipts for this client.

capture.queue.reason.not_found.nl: De reeks waar deze bon bij hoort bestaat niet meer.
capture.queue.reason.not_found.en: The batch this receipt belongs to no longer exists.

capture.queue.reason.first_page_blocked.note: Not a refusal of this page. The first page of its receipt was refused, so there is no receipt for this one to join — and sending it alone would open a second receipt for half an invoice (ADR-031 §3).
capture.queue.reason.first_page_blocked.nl: De eerste pagina van deze bon is geweigerd, dus deze pagina kan er niet bij.
capture.queue.reason.first_page_blocked.en: The first page of this receipt was refused, so this page cannot join it.

capture.queue.reason.rejected.note: The catch-all. Says plainly that the queue does not know, rather than inventing a cause — and keeps the file, so nothing is lost while somebody finds out.
capture.queue.reason.rejected.nl: Deze bon is geweigerd. De foto staat nog op dit apparaat.
capture.queue.reason.rejected.en: This receipt was refused. The photograph is still on this device.

capture.queue.full.note: MOB-009's cap reached. The advice is the action that actually frees space — the queue never evicts a queued receipt to make room, because that would destroy the only copy of a photograph.
capture.queue.full.nl: De wachtrij is vol. Ga online zodat de wachtende bonnen geüpload worden, of gooi er een weg.
capture.queue.full.en: The queue is full. Get online so the waiting receipts upload, or discard one.

capture.queue.too_large.note: Distinct from 'full': clearing the queue would not help, because this one file is larger than the whole budget.
capture.queue.too_large.nl: Dit bestand is groter dan de hele wachtrij. Maak een nieuwe foto of upload het als er verbinding is.
capture.queue.too_large.en: This file is larger than the whole queue. Take a new photograph, or upload it while there is a connection.

capture.queue.purge_warning.note: MOB-009 purges the queue on logout, role change and remote wipe, which destroys captures that never uploaded. Shown BEFORE the person signs out — the requirement is not negotiable, so the least this can do is not be a surprise.

nl.one: {count} bon is nog niet geüpload en gaat verloren als u uitlogt.
nl.other: {count} bonnen zijn nog niet geüpload en gaan verloren als u uitlogt.

en.one: {count} receipt has not uploaded yet and will be lost when you sign out.
en.other: {count} receipts have not uploaded yet and will be lost when you sign out.
